where: Proposition 5.13, the case of two components

paper text.text:
Proposition~\ref{prop:three-root-disjoint} give
$T(g),T(s),T(t),S(s;t),S(t;s),Q(g;s,t)$ or the two four-cycle
forms of Lemma~\ref{core:two-cap-critical}: nine forms in all.

Each replacement keeps the interior of $B$ connected and all four
attachments. For each $g$, combine one of these nine bridges,
two singleton interiors, or an empty interior, with $st=au,av,uv$ and permitted original
edges $gs,gt$, excluding $ag$. For empty interior, join $g$ to
$u$, $v$, or both.
Every combination is a subgraph of a recorded toroidal graph
or contains a recorded nontoroidal subgraph~\supp{E13}.
A DRAT proof in the same item certifies completeness.
The remaining checks leave only $\mathfrak T_{51},\mathfrak T_{72}$,
with no two-singleton interior.

Finally suppose that two components contain $b,c,d$.
Let $D_1$ contain $x,y$, let $D_2$ contain $g$, and let $B_1,B_2$
be their bridges on $X$.
Their neighborhoods lie among
$\{u\},\{v\},\{a,u\},\{a,v\},\{u,v\}$ and together contain $u,v$.
Apply Lemma~\ref{core:assembly-general} to each augmented graph.
A component adjacent to all of $X$ makes the test fail.
Otherwise complete each two-attachment bridge by its attachment edge.
This gives the table, up to interchanging $u,v$ and $c,d$.
The last column requires nonplanarity, and ``none'' means all four
tests already fail.
\begin{center}
\scaledtable{1.1}{%
\begin{tabular}{lll}
\toprule
$D_1$ contains&neighborhoods&remaining condition\\\midrule
$b,c$&$D_1:\{u\},\{a,u\}$; $D_2:\{u,v\}$&none\\
$b,c$&$D_1:\{u\},\{a,u\}$; $D_2:\{v\},\{a,v\}$&$B_2+av+ad$, or \eqref{r2:hard-tests}\\
$b,c$&$D_1:\{u,v\}$; $D_2:\{u,v\}$&none\\
$b,c$&$D_1:\{u,v\}$; $D_2:\{v\},\{a,v\}$&$B_1+uv+bc$ or $B_2+av+ad$\\
$c,d$&one neighborhood is $\{u,v\}$&none\\
$c,d$&$D_1:\{u\},\{a,u\}$; $D_2:\{v\},\{a,v\}$&$B_1+au+ac+ad$ or $B_2+av+ab$\\\bottomrule
\end{tabular}%
}
\end{center}

The preceding reduction applies to $D_2$. Its two-singleton form
is impossible: delete one singleton. Tests joining $D_1,D_2$ or
making $D_2$ adjacent to all of $X$ still fail. In any other test,
the relevant completion of $B_2$ is planar before and after deletion,
being a subgraph of $K_5$ minus the edge between the singletons.
The attachments and connected interior remain, contradicting
minimality. Thus $D_2$ has one of the nine forms or empty interior.

For a required failure of $B_1+uv+xy$, use
Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction} with attachments
$x,y,u,v$, added edges $xy,uv$, required edge $xy$, and original
pairs $xu,xv,yu,yv$. The edge $xy$ is required since $B_1+uv$ is planar, using $up'v$.
Keep $N_B(D_1)$, $D_1$ connected, and $(B_1-\{x,y\})+uv$ connected.
Every retained interior component keeps a neighbor at $u$ or $v$.
Lemma~\ref{r2:retained-components} permits two further components,
one joining $x,y$ and one supplying a missing neighbor at $u$ or $v$.
For $B_1+au+ac+ad$, use attachments $a,c,d,u$, added edges
$au,ac,ad$, and original pairs $cu,du$. Keep $D_1$ and
$B_1-\{a,c,d\}$ connected. Every interior component meets $u$,
so one further component suffices to join $c,d$.
If $D_1$ meets $a$, a retained component must do so.
Otherwise deleting its edges at $a$ preserves all four failures.

When no subdivision is needed in $D_1$, its edges at $a$
may be deleted: the automatic failures reach $a$ through
added edges, and any remaining failure is supplied by $B_2$. When no subdivision is needed in $D_1$, retain a path $xty$ with $t\in V(D_1)$ and one of
\[
tu,\quad tv,\quad tu+tv,\quad tu+xv,\quad tu+yv,
\quad tv+xu,\quad tv+yu.
\]
Contract a component needed only for an attaching edge into an
attachment, deleting any resulting $xy$.
In rows requiring no additional failure, contract $D_2-g$
into $g$ and delete any resulting $ag$, retaining its neighbors
in $\{u,v\}$. The automatic failures remain, since they reach
$a$ through added edges. Otherwise combine with its nine forms
or empty interior and all permitted original edges.

Row two also requires simultaneous failures when $B_2+av+ad$ is planar.
Put $H_1=B_1+\{a,u\}+au$, planar using $ap'u$. The conditions are
\begin{equation}
H_1+bc\text{ nonplanar},\qquad H_1+ab+ac\text{ nonplanar}.
\label{r2:hard-tests}
\end{equation}
Replace $B_2$ by $dv$. Three original tests still contain one of
these graphs as a minor using $ap'u$. In $B+ac+bd$, use the
internally disjoint paths $ap'u,aq'vdb$ for $au,ab$.
Thus minimality forces $V(D_2)=\{d\}$ with edge $dv$.

The graph $H_2=H_1+ab+ac+bc$ is a $K_5$-minor-free minor of $H_0$.
Every component of $D_1-\{b,c\}$ meets $u$, and $b,c$ have neighbors
there or at $u$. Consequently $H_1-\{a,b,c\}$ is connected and
adjacent to all three attachments, and $H_2-a$, $H_2-\{a,b\}$,
$H_2-\{a,c\}$ are connected.
A cut of order at most two avoiding $a$ would also separate $G$,
since its surviving vertices of $\{a,b,c,u\}$ remain joined through
$a$. Hence $H_2$ is two-connected and every two-cut contains $a$
and avoids $b,c$.

Lemma~\ref{r2:three-mark-entrance} gives a subdivision
$H_3\subseteq H_1+bc$ using $bc$, with $H_3-bc+ab+ac$ nonplanar.
Apply Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction} with attachments
$a,b,c,u$, added edges $bc,au$, and required edge $bc$.
Shorten to $H_3'$, preserving the position or absence of $a$ and
allowing direct segments at $u$. Since every interior component
meets $u$, contract the remaining vertices onto
$(V(H_3')\cap\operatorname{Int}(B))\cup\{u\}$ and retain a minimal
connecting forest. Keep $u,p',q'$. Any edge $au$ created by the contractions
is already present in $H_1$.
The interior remains connected through $p'$, and the attachments
remain through $p',q'$, $H_3'-bc$, and $dv$.
Lemma~\ref{r2:position-of-third} preserves both failures in
\eqref{r2:hard-tests}, so minimality forces this reduction.
At most one length-two segment from $a$ to $b,c$ remains:
two would, with $bc$, give a cycle through at most three branch
vertices of $K_{3,3}$.
Include every position of $u$, also outside $H_3$, and every
minimal connecting forest through it.

The combinations in~\supp{E14} include both
partitions and all permitted original edges. A proper minor preserving
the neighborhoods, connectivity and planar completions in the table
may be discarded before combination, by the replacement argument.
The $1{,}229$ resulting candidates are all excluded by the recorded
checks. Thus the two-component case gives no obstruction, and
the first two cases give the stated list.
\end{proof}

construction of D_1.no subdivision: a path x t y with t in D_1 and some of tu, tv, ta, original edges xu, xv, yu, yv, and possibly a second single vertex (a superset of the seven forms of the text)
construction of D_1.B_1 + uv + xy nonplanar (P1, N(D_1) = {u: Construction 3.16 with attachments b, c, u, v, added edges bc, uv, required edge bc, original pairs bu, bv, cu, cv as an edge or a once-subdivided segment
construction of D_1.the hard tests of row two (P1): Construction 3.16 with attachments a, b, c, u, added edges bc, au, required edge bc, original pairs bu, cu; the interior pieces and u joined into one connected graph by every forest
construction of D_1.B_1 + au + ac + ad nonplanar (P2, N(D_1): Construction 3.16 with attachments a, c, d, u, added edges au, ac, ad, the subdivision using ac or ad, original pairs cu, du as an edge or a once-subdivided segment
construction of D_1.completion (Construction 3.16(ii), Lemma: the interior pieces are divided into components in every way and joined by every forest; then at most two further single vertices are added, with every admissible neighbourhood, and every inclusion-minimal set of attaching edges from the retained components (and, for B_1 + uv + xy, of original edges xu, xv, yu, yv) that makes every interior component meet u or v (u, for the other two constructions) and x or y, makes D_1 connected, gives u and v a neighbour in D_1 where N(D_1) = {u,v}, and gives a a neighbour in a retained component where N(D_1) = {a,u}; the whole configuration is minimal. Mirror images under u <-> v are included.
construction of D_1.reduction: forms with a one-step proper minor of the same signature (neighbourhood and planar completions) that meets the same conditions are removed
